problems.problem: The concept's 'hard-edge slab sunk behind the ring centre to hold the lower silhouette' is executed as a 0.12-opacity #0d3a44 rectangle (spec x250-830, y605-1045; visible in poster 1 as the grey-teal wash whose top edge cuts the flacon at the shoulder and whose side edges sit at approx x250/x830). At 12% ink it reads as a translucent misprint panel floating over the rings, not a solid plate: the ripple rings stay fully visible through it and its four hard edges create a second, competing frame around the hero. R1/R2's plaque contrast comes from solid dark plates; this wash undermines both the slab idea and the ring field.

The lower plaque card (approx y1118-1382) is internally unbalanced: the two title lines and the full-width rule hug the left edge (title bbox x108-727), leaving the card's right third (approx x730-1020) empty for both text lines, while the 'Guerlain' logotype (bbox x463-618) is centered on the canvas and therefore sits off-axis relative to the left-set title block beneath it. The two type elements share one card but two different grids, so the plaque lacks the resolved internal order of R2's plate typography.

The 'Guerlain' logotype at 28px with tracking 6 measures only about 155px wide against an 864px plaque (logo bbox 463-618 vs decoration 108-972): it reads as a floating speck rather than the plaque's brand header, and its optical weight is far below the 66px title it is supposed to crown. Hierarchy inside the plaque (brand / title / rule) is therefore under-differentiated at the brand line.
